title: Intense Near-IR Emission from Nanoscale Lanthanoid Fluoride Clusters

material_class.structural_family: Lanthanoid fluoride cluster capped by pyridine and phenylselenolate

synthesis.procedure: Under ultrapure nitrogen, Pr, diphenyl diselenide, and mercury were combined in pyridine and stirred at room temperature until the Pr powder was consumed (about 1 day). Ammonium fluoride was added to the pale yellow-green solution. After about 1 week of stirring, the solution was filtered, concentrated, and cooled to crystallize compound 1.
synthesis.temperature: Room temperature for reaction; −5 °C for crystallization
synthesis.time: About 1 day before ammonium fluoride addition; about 1 week afterward; 1 day for crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Dry-box or Schlenk techniques under ultrapure nitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered, concentrated to ca. 15 mL, and held at −5 °C for 1 day, yielding small colorless lathes.

properties.summary: An optical absorption maximum is reported for the Pr cluster in the supplemental material; no Pr emission result is reported.

source_locations.location: Supplemental Material embedded in supplied Markdown, Experimental Section: synthesis of 1
Embedded Supplemental Material, X-ray Structure Determination

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A central set of four 12-coordinate Pr ions is encapsulated by bridging fluoride ions and surrounded by 24 further Pr ions. Additional bridging fluorides connect the outer ions; pyridine and phenylselenolate cap the cluster surface.

material_class.structural_family: Lanthanoid fluoride cluster capped by pyridine and phenylselenolate

synthesis.procedure: Under ultrapure nitrogen, Nd, diphenyl diselenide, and mercury were combined in pyridine and stirred at room temperature until the Nd flakes were consumed (about 2 days). Ammonium fluoride was added. After at least 2 weeks, the brown-orange solution was filtered and crystallized by concentration followed either by hexane layering or by cooling.
synthesis.temperature: Room temperature for reaction; −5 °C for the cooling crystallization option
synthesis.time: About 2 days before ammonium fluoride addition; at least 2 weeks afterward; 1 day for cooling crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Dry-box or Schlenk techniques under ultrapure nitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After filtration, either concentrate to ca. 20 mL and layer with hexanes at a 1:1 ratio, or concentrate to ca. 15 mL and cool at −5 °C for 1 day. The cooling route furnished crystals suitable for full single-crystal structure determination; the layered crystals had lattice defects.

properties.summary: Under 800 nm excitation, the Nd cluster exhibits near-IR emission at 1076 and 1335 nm. The reported calculated quantum efficiency for the 1076 nm transition is 41%.

measurements.name: Fluorescence decay time
measurements.conditions: 1076 nm emission; fitted decay curve as reported

measurements.name: Calculated quantum efficiency
measurements.conditions: 1076 nm emission; calculated from experimental and radiative decay times
